newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks directionless in thin London trade.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks directionless in thin London trade.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were mixed in thin trading on Monday, with business at a low level ahead of a Japanese public holiday Thursday and elections due at the end of the month for the lower Japanese house, traders said. The Nikkei 50 index of leading Japanese stocks traded here was up 0.22 points or 0.02 percent at 1,439.23 by 1430 GMT, continuing a mixed performance in Tokyo where the Nikkei 225 closed 12.98 points or 0.06 percent higher at 21,161.01.
"Last night Tokyo volume was at is lowest level this year and that trend has certainly followed through in London," said one trader at a leading Japanese securities house here.

"There are a hell of a lot of reasons for people to do nothing, the Nikkei has hung around the 21,000 level for the past two or three weeks and there is nothing much to push it decisively either way."
He said the market was also on hold ahead of long-awaited listing of West Japan Railway Co tomorrow.
"People are waiting to see how that flotation goes but I don't expect it to have much impact on the market either way."
